rowText.steps: Turn a capability off (e.g. Steam ban lookup), trigger the blocked action, press Open Permissions, read where the highlight lands, press Back.
rowText.expected: Highlight lands on the exact toggle named (e.g. Steam ban lookup); Back returns to the prior tab. Known bug: it currently lands one row above.

steps_taken: Turned Steam ban lookup off on the Permissions tab.
Typed 'bonsai:vac-check' into the Ask field (via the PC helper script, not thumb-typed) and pressed Ask.
Got the instant blocked-action reply: 'Enable Steam ban lookup in Permissions to use bonsai:vac-check.' with an Open Permissions button below it.
Read where the D-pad ring landed on the Permissions tab.
Pressed A on the button there to go back.
Restored Steam ban lookup to on afterwards.

reads.afterOpenPermissions: tab switched to PERMS; the D-pad ring landed on a 'Back to Main' button at the very top of the tab, with the page scrolled to the top (first toggle, 'Read game & screenshot context', showing just below). No highlight, scroll, or ring reached the Steam ban lookup row itself -- there is no CSS highlight class anywhere on the page pointing at it either.

reads.pressedBackToMain: returned to the MAIN tab, with the ring back on the same 'Open Permissions' button, and the vac-check reply still on screen.

verdictSentence: Pressing Open Permissions does not land the highlight on the Steam ban lookup switch, or even one row above it as the older bug said -- it opens the Permissions page scrolled to the very top with the ring on a 'Back to Main' button, so a person still has to scroll and find the switch themselves; the Back button itself does correctly return to the same spot on the Main tab.
